topic: Choose a CRM tool for a small sales team

scenario.topic: Choose a CRM tool for a small sales team
scenario.opening_question: What matters more to you: ease of use or advanced customization?

options.name: HubSpot CRM Free Plan
options.upside: No cost with solid core features and many integrations
options.tradeoff: Limited advanced automation and reporting features
options.concern: May require paid upgrades as team or needs grow
options.best_for: teams prioritizing zero cost and easy onboarding

options.name: Zoho CRM Standard Edition
options.upside: Good balance of features and customization at affordable price
options.tradeoff: Somewhat steeper learning curve compared to simpler tools
options.concern: Occasional interface glitches reported by users
options.best_for: teams needing moderate customization within budget

options.name: Pipedrive Essential Plan
options.upside: Excellent visual sales pipeline and easy deal tracking
options.tradeoff: Limited email automation and reporting features
options.concern: Might lack depth for complex sales processes
options.best_for: teams focused on visual pipeline management

options.name: Salesforce Essentials Edition
options.upside: Powerful automation and strong customer support
options.tradeoff: Higher cost and more complex setup for small teams
options.concern: May be overwhelming for users new to CRM systems
options.best_for: teams wanting advanced features and dedicated support

shared_context: We are a small sales team of exactly 2 people.
Our monthly budget for CRM tools is capped at $50.
We want a CRM that helps track leads and improves follow-ups.

personas.name: Yara
personas.background: Yara values cost-efficiency and ease of onboarding for small teams new to CRM tools.
personas.private_goal: She wants a CRM that is free to start with and can handle growth without complexity.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative

personas.name: Vince
personas.background: Vince focuses on reliable features and moderate customization to support a growing sales team.
personas.private_goal: He wants a CRM that balances affordability with customization and decent mobile support.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative

C) Pipedrive Essential Plan — cost: $15 per user per month; email integration: basic; pipeline visualization: strong (+ Excellent visual sales pipeline and easy deal tracking; − Limited email automation and reporting features)
